title: Build123dPart
description: Handle to a part built by the build123d tool server. The server keeps no state between calls, so the handle carries the parameters the part is rebuilt from. part_id is derived from those parameters; a handle whose part_id does not match them is rejected.

part_id.description: sha256 of the canonical JSON of plate. Equal parameters give an equal part_id.

plate.description: The create_plate arguments this part was built from.
